findings: Inspected the full-frame contact sheet and both original/overlay target-crop sheets for these nine actual source frames. The same beige-shirt participant remains localized while approaching a wooden stool, sitting, turning while seated, standing and stepping away. Head, torso, arms and visible legs remain localized through the pose changes; the stool and seated background observer remain excluded. Visible far-leg regions behind the stool are retained at sampled frames 149, 199, 298 and 348, without filling the wooden stool into the human mask. Fine boundaries and heavily occluded far-leg detail, particularly frame 249, are not certified pixel accurate by this sampled review. No identity switch, broad background takeover, empty target localization or major visible-body omission was observed. Independently recomputed camera aggregation and consistency checks from raw per-frame estimates. These are estimated camera intrinsics; Body inference has not run. Body uses masks for both bounding-box localization and direct conditioning, so input approval is not a reconstruction-quality claim.
